title: Banks Act Directive D1/2012 — Information to be included in applications in terms of the Securitisation Notice – Designation of an activity not falling within the meaning of 'the business of a bank' (Securitisation Notice)
enablingLegislation: Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990)

sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: This directive is issued by the Prudential Authority in terms of Section 6(6)(a) of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Information to be included in applications in terms of the Securitisation Notice – Designation of an activity not falling within the meaning of 'the business of a bank' (Securitisation Notice).

sections.heading: Application
sections.text: This directive applies to all banks, branches of foreign institutions and controlling companies registered or operating in South Africa in terms of the Banks Act, 1990 (Act No. 94 of 1990). Information to be included in applications in terms of the Securitisation Notice – Designation of an activity not falling within the meaning of 'the business of a bank' (Securitisation Notice).

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: Information to be included in applications in terms of the Securitisation Notice – Designation of an activity not falling within the meaning of 'the business of a bank' (Securitisation Notice). Institutions are required to ensure compliance with the requirements set out herein. This directive remains effective as confirmed in Banks Act Circular 1 of the relevant year.
